notes.title: Downward: Enhanced Edition: Available NOW
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27111670/89a54d0540c3ca33499709661eb9c53ce4fc67fe.jpg[/img]

Hi Community,

Downward: Enhanced Edition is available NOW! Head over to the store and download the new version!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/506900/Downward_Enhanced_Edition/

The enhanced edition is a free update for those who already have the game, feel free to play it again and maybe you'll find something interesting! 👀

[previewyoutube=SLQYkT4yqwc;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]Message from the devs: [/h2]
[Quote=Caracal Games] Even if we are super excited about this new, better version of Downward, and despite the significant improvements in every aspect of the new version of the game, we still believe that the old version has a unique charm. There are some scenes, like the very first one, that, despite being extremely demanding in terms of performance and technically imperfect, maintain an exceptional look and feel to which we are very attached. For this reason, we have decided to allow players to play the old version through a specific branch. [/quote] 
Here are the patch notes in details, feel free to check it out. 
[hr][/hr] [h3]Story[/h3]
[list]
[*] Redundancies have been cut, and the order of several lines of text has been reorganized to make the story more understandable and enjoyable.
[*] Introduction lore text has been added to introduce the story at the very beginning of the game.
[*] Additional content at the end of the story ('epilogue' DLC) enriches the ending and provides a new perspective on the story. You can still make different choices at the end of the story based on the completion of the Skull quest, activation of all the gears, and collection of the Dry Artifacts.
[*] New tutorial levels have been added to the main story for every unlocked power.
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
[list]
[*] Platforming is slightly more forgiving.
[*] The skill tree has been restructured and redundancies have been cut.
[*] New bosses have been added to fight during the story to obtain relics and artifacts.
[*] The savegames of the new version won't work with the old one.
[*] You will be able to play the old version in the beta.
[/list]
[h3]Aesthetic[/h3]
[list]
[*] Every key asset of the game has been re-imagined from scratch to give a coherent look to the game's technology, in particular:
[olist]
[*] Save Bells
[*] Fast Travel Portals
[*] Level Entrances
[*] Planet Activators
[*] Challenge Activators
[*] Level-Up Statues
[*] Relics Altar
[*] Environmental Gears
[*] Turrets
[/olist] [*] 99.9% of the 3D models have been redone by hand, and every texture has been updated.
[*] Some areas have been aesthetically re-imagined, drastically in some cases.
[*] All enemies have an updated look.
[/list] 
[h3]Fixes[/h3] 
[list]
[*] Given that the code has been fundamentally restructured and this version is the result of a process that has taken place intermittently over the last six years, it is difficult to provide a precise list of fixed bugs. All the bugs that have been reported and that we were able to reproduce have been resolved.
[/list]
[h3]Legibility[/h3]
[list]
[*] Level design has been massively updated to be more intuitive at first glance.
[*] Anomalies have an updated look and are now easier to spot.
[*] Due to the vertical nature of the game, we replaced the old "Skyrim-like" compass with a system of screen icons, making every objective and point of interest easier to spot.
[/list]
[h3]Performance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Massive optimizations have been made (the game now runs at 60 FPS on the Steam Deck at full resolution without upscaling, whereas before it struggled to maintain 20 FPS).
[*] FSR and RSR have been added, but we are confident that they will not be needed for the vast majority of players.
[/list] [hr][/hr] Cheers,

notes.title: PMCW Intelligence Document No. 010178. Codename: Vorax
notes.content:
PMCW Intelligence Document No. 010178.

Information in our possession is conflicting, but it seems that the infection has spread very quickly within a few days, perhaps even in a few hours.
It seems that in the hours immediately following the outbreak of the infection, 43rd NATO airborne battalion was sent to the island but all contacts were lost after only 8 hours.

PMCW considers this matter with the utmost importance.
Objectives of team W1 are:
[list]
[*] Locate the biolab
[*] Take in vitro samples of the pathogen (codename: "Vorax")
[*] Liquidate surviving medical personnel (optionally) and any witnesses.
[/list]
[b]In NO case must the presence of the PMCW be revealed.[/b]
 
Every W1 squad member is equipped with cyanide capsules. 
Squad commander is authorized to start liquidation procedure in case of emergency.

Proceed with the utmost caution.

[previewyoutube=-xl04-CDLv0;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]THE ENVIRONMENT[/b]

The island is vast and offers a wide variety of natural resources. There are also several settlements, a main village, a hotel and tourist attractions.
In the event of an emergency landing, or loss of tactical equipment, each squad member is trained to survive in a hostile environment.
As a good mercenary of a private military company, you know how to use local plants and herbs to make ointments and medications to treat state effects such as burns, bleeding, relieve your stress or simply restore your health.
But more importantly, you can use building materials provided by nature to make rudimentary melee weapons, traps, barricades and much more.  Even a silent bow, very useful for knocking out the infected without being detected.

[b]THE INFECTION[/b]

It seems that the infected are the side effect of the virus grown in the bio-laboratory.
Probably when a security flaw opened, the virus spread to the island.

It is not yet clear whether it spreads by air or through aquifers but what is certain is that biomass, similar to fleshy appendages that are sometimes glimpsed in the environment, are one of the final stages of the virus.
The biomass therefore seems to be responsible for the mutations that occurred to the civilian inhabitants and to the military personnel who rushed to contain the first stages of the infection.
[b]Contact with non-bottled liquids or non-canned food is therefore  strictly prohibited.[/b]

Mutates are fast, extremely aggressive and above all voracious.
The first to be devoured were the breeding animals of the surrounding farms and estates.
For this reason, any living being, human or animal, is for them a [b]prey[/b].

Apparently they do not devour each other ( to be confirmed ).

Finally, it seems that they are photosensitive. 
At least the infected humans.
Our drones have in fact observed the absence of external diurnal activity by the mutants, even if some animal species that have come into contact with the pathogen, such as stray dogs, wolves, wild boars and bears, do not seem to suffer from photosensitivity.

[b]It is therefore recommended to exercise extreme caution at night.[/b]


[b]OPERATIONAL INFO[/b]

You will land in the North area, a few hundred meters from the bio-laboratory, at 4.30 in the morning.
The helicopter will wait 25 minutes and then will take off.

[b]Firstly[/b], Die Young is now available on the [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-en/product/EP2421-CUSA18768_00-INDIEGALADYG0001?utm_source=mail_t&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=Weekend_20210116]PlayStation Store.[/url] We know it may seem a bit odd to some for us to post an announcement here on Steam, but we simply couldn't contain our excitement and we wanted to share it with our fans, especially the ones who have been requesting this version for a while now.

For those lucky few who have managed to get a PS5...to play this game on [b]PS5[/b], your system may need to be updated to the latest system software. Unfortunately the US release will take place at the end of this month, but it is on its way nevertheless.

[b]Secondly[/b], we have not forgotten about our PC fans. [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/433170/Die_Young/]Die Young[/url] just got updated on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/433170/Die_Young/]Steam[/url]. Here are the release notes:

Below is the changelog with the most important fixes, mainly stuff that we did for Ps4 submission but there are few nice goodies:

CHANGELOG ver 1.2.5

- fix for a bug that didn't trigger Good Ending (player got stuck in the final arena after killing all enemies).

- fix for a new exploit to Biofuel Refinery (allowed to collect the Fuel Can before having the Lighter, generating the Generator bug at the Radio Tower)

- fix to animations dogs / wolves / Cujo (the rotations were broken)

- fix farmer animations (animations were broken and some farmers skidded from one point to another in their paths)

- AI perception fix (enemies were stuck indefinitely if they perceived a sound from an unreachable point)

- Fix for junkie AI (remained motionless after taking a few hits)

- fix for bug in  The Collector shop (deleted some items, without giving them, if bought in case of full inventory)

- fix for various graphic bugs

- various fixes in level design

Enjoy!

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27111670/91efb7b26acbb7c92dadd86799d2b3da52d1a7b2.png[/img]

Hi Guys!

Finally, here we are! The Downward 1.0 version has been released and we are out from Early Access!
We are very proud of ourselves and, above all, we are proud of the Downward community that helped us so much in these six monts, allowing us to come out from EA (which not very common these days): thank you all!

[h1][b]Version 1.0 [/b][/h1]

So with Downward v1.0 among other things we have finally the full story and the three alternative endings (we can say the endings are "Dark Souls like", so please don't expect some "The Witcher" or "Mass Effect" stuff, we are a small indie team after all!!). Unlocking the two extra endings will allow you to discover the final lore elements about the different characters, and let you make different choices at the very end of the game.

[h1][b]Support[/b][/h1]

Of course, we will continue the constant support to the game after the full release, not only to fix reported stuff etc. but also to keep some promises we made:

- Linux full release build is our first duty, as promised we will work on this straightway.
- Updating the demo, (the actual demo is quite old at the moment)
- Fps optimization
- Other minor adjustments

Thank you all,
Caracal Team

Try to collect them all!

Best,
Caracal Team

Hi!
With this week's update climbing has been extended to all ledges in the game!
As requested by the community, this new approach gives even more room to creativity in the parkour, making also the whole system more forgiving.
Like every week we are releasing a new challenge, and we also moved to version 0.48!


[h1][b]v0.48 Changelog[/b][/h1]

[h1][b]Parkour[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Extended parkour climb to all ledges.[/b]
[*]Fixed a bug with "vertical wall run" maneuver animation.
[*]Minor parkour bug fixes.
[/list]
[h1][b]Areas[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Reorganized specific areas in all maps to make gameplay experience more intuitive and fun.
[*]Improved DOF effect in specific areas.
[*]Improved post-processing effects in closed areas.
[*]Improved lighting in several areas of the world.
[*]Revised all vegetation materials, which now react better to light sources and have a more realistic feeling to them.
[*]Streaming level system has been polished in Winter Sea and Crossroads areas.
[*]Cactus have been re-texturized.
[/list]
[h1][b]Anomalies[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Double Jump:[/b]
[list]
[*]Active color has been changed from light blue to a more noticeable one.
[*]Added a sound effect when using a Double Jump anomaly.
[/list]
[*][b]Slingshot:[/b]
[list]
[*]Anomaly color activation is now based on distance.
When near enough, the color of the slingshot anomaly will change from red to blue, indicating that it is in range for being targeted and hooked.
[*]Now there are only two color states: red for not active/not in range and blue for active/in range.
[*]Pressing the Focus button is no longer necessary in order to target and hook a slingshot anomaly.
[*]As soon as a slingshot anomaly is aimed at, a projectile trail will be spawned.
[*]Added a sound effect when a slingshot anomaly is hooked.
[*]Added a cable component effect when a slingshot anomaly is hooked.
[*]Fixed a bug with anomaly pulling stoppage due to solid objects, now any kind of movement will stop immediately.
[/list]
[/list]
[h1][b]Enemies[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Golems:[/b]
[list]
[*]New fight soundtrack from our awesome Composer!
[*]Added three new fight patterns in golem's behaviour, all of which include the new attack type "spikes blast". This new attack comes in two variants:
[list]
[*]Version one: faster attack with smaller AoE.
[*]Version two:  slower attack with larger AoE.
[/list]
[*]Now certain golems have multiple cores that power them.
[/list]
[*][b]Drones:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed drones' draw distance.
[/list]
[/list]
[h1][b]Collectibles[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Mechanisms' levers have been visually overhauled with a new kind of interaction and animation.
[*]Mechanisms' gears have been enlarged and accurately placed to better fit with the environment.
[/list]
[h1][b]Interactables[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Most interactables (doors, buttons, levers, anomalies, collectibles) have now a bluish shade/color and are easier to spot. 
[*]Added a new particle on fountains and upgrade statues to make them more visible.
[/list]
[h1][b]Main Quest[/b][/h1]
[list]
